extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and editors (general public and contributors)
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikipedia-style encyclopedic overview of the Gamergate controversy, covering its timeline, key actors, impacts, and references. The page is written for general readers and for editors who may maintain or improve the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid overly lengthy quotations / summarize long quotes
rubrics_metrics.description: This section contains overly lengthy quotations. Please help summarize the quotations. Consider transferring direct quotations to Wikiquote or excerpts to Wikisource.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editors should shorten long quoted passages by summarizing them in the article body, moving extensive direct quotations to Wikiquote, or transferring excerpts to Wikisource where appropriate. Follow Wikipedia guidance on when and how to remove the 'overly lengthy quotations' notice and preserve verifiability by keeping relevant citations and references.
